name: Create CalendarView.tsx month view
description: Implement month calendar view with day grid, event indicators, and day selection

details: Render day cells with padding days from previous/next month
Apply artifact styling (min-h-[14vh], borders, hover states)
Query events for each day using eventMapper

Clicking day triggers day detail view
